text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm planning a short rollout of the telemetry tweaks that change dashboard panels + alert thresholds for the batching improvements. Targeting today at 10:30 PDT. Who's owning the deploy and the smoke checks?

rohit: I can take the deploy. It's a config-only change to telemetry rules + a small tracer sampling bump. Doing it from the dedicated control plane. ETA 10:30-10:40.

sam: Quick ask: which panels are changing? I want to know what to look at in Grafana so I don't miss regressions.

maria: Thanks Sam — panels: "reqs/token-rate per model", "kv-cache hit ratio", and the new "batching latency (95p)" panel. Also a single-trace view linked from the model endpoint traces.

elaine: For alerts: we're temporarily raising the 95p latency threshold by 30% for the next 20m after deploy to avoid noisy pages while caches warm. I'll post exact numbers in the runbook now.

nico: On rollback readiness — if anything spikes, we should be able to flip the telemetry config back. Command is: `redwoodctl platform apply -f telemetry-config.yaml --rollback-to previous` or revert via the console (Deploy -> Configs -> Revert). I can stay on standby for rollback.

rohit: Deploy plan: 1) push config, 2) wait 2m for KV cache metrics to appear, 3) run smoke script (see below), 4) promote. If the smoke script fails, we rollback.

rohit: Smoke script (run from ci-agent):
```
./scripts/smoke-telemetry.sh --endpoints model-a,model-b --load 10rps --duration 90s
# asserts: 95p latency < 400ms, kv-cache hit > 70%, error-rate < 0.5%
```

maria: I'll coordinate with product and leave a slack note to customers if we need to change the SLA window.

sam: I'll watch the dashboards and trace links. What channel should I post in if I see something odd?

elaine: Post here and tag @oncall. Also do a quick snippet in the runbook: timestamp + what panel you saw spike + screenshot link.

maria: One more: set trace sampling to 2x for 15m after deployment so we have better trace coverage for root cause if needed. Elaine, can you update that in the runbook?

elaine: Yup will add.

deploy-bot: Deployment started by rohit at 1769001720. Config: telemetry-config v2.3. Initiating apply to dedicated pool.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation is @nico for the next 12 hours. Use `@nico` for urgent rollbacks.

rohit: Apply complete at 1769001805. Waiting 2m for metrics to populate.

sam: Seeing initial metrics — kv-cache hit at ~68% (just under target), 95p latency stable, a couple of traces showing longer tail for model-b. Running the smoke script now.

sam: Smoke results: all checks passed except kv-cache hit slightly low (68% vs 70%). No errors.

maria: Given low but recovering cache hit, we'll hold promotion for 10m and keep thresholds relaxed. If it doesn't hit 70% in 10m, we rollback.

nico: I'm monitoring. No paging yet.

rohit: Ack. Will keep the revert command ready.

sam: 10m later — kv-cache hit 75%. Promoting the config to full.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete at 1769001965. Telemetry-config v2.3 promoted to full.

maria: Sweet. Thanks everyone. Postmortem note: add a follow-up to test pre-warm cache strategy for model-b next sprint.

elaine: I'll add the follow-up + exact numbers to the runbook and set the alert thresholds back to normal after 20m window.

nico: Closing watch. Ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
